loss_normalization.sample: each sample has total candidate mass 1
loss_normalization.instance: positive mass is divided equally among truth instances and then among their candidates; negative mass is separate
loss_normalization.validity: when both signs exist, positives and negatives each receive 0.5 sample mass
loss_normalization.candidate_faces: membership, boundary, and semantic loss are averaged within each valid candidate before candidate weighting
loss_normalization.class: positive macro classes use the frozen inverse-frequency class weights and validity uses its frozen positive weight
